<assessment>SOURCE is one street-level oblique view showing the tower’s broad frontage and right return, leftward setbacks, connected low wing, planted terrace pockets, pale projecting grid, recessed openings and darker lower facade zone. CURRENT 10–12 retain these main relationships and now show consistent six-front/five-side tower subdivisions. However, the tower’s opening arrangement remains different: prominent near-corner recesses occur higher in CURRENT, while SOURCE’s distinctive planted corner recess sits lower, closer to the darker facade zone. CURRENT 11 demonstrates improved enclosed terrace pockets and connected perimeter edges; the earlier continuous projecting-tray complaint is no longer supported. No obvious floating rail or slab penetration is established by these captures. Rear elevations, concealed joints and exact recess depths remain inferred. The absent neighbor and street context conflict with the older neighbor requirement, but the recorded removal intent prevents recommending restoration without a valid feature-specific scope reconciliation.</assessment>

action: Locally reconcile only identifiable source-facing recesses and their infill positions, restoring the lower corner pocket and readable full-height recessed openings where shown. Preserve the corrected six/five subdivisions, existing floor elevations and already-complete loggia assemblies.</issue>
